DECODE_DURATION_SLO.justification: Decode service time must be evaluated against the same continuation prompt family.

threshold.procedure: Calibrate in a dedicated pre-campaign SLO calibration step before Phase 6 formal outcomes exist. Use one-sided future-run prediction limits with alpha=0.05. Formal Phase 6 outcome data must not be used to set thresholds.

DECODE_DURATION_SLO.violation_definition: run-level p95 post-first-token duration > calibrated threshold

SECONDS_PER_OUTPUT_TOKEN_DIAGNOSTIC.aggregation_level: run-level median over successful requests with output tokens
SECONDS_PER_OUTPUT_TOKEN_DIAGNOSTIC.justification: Token-normalized decode descriptor is highly redundant with post-first-token duration for this campaign.

threshold.procedure: diagnostic reference only; not counted as an independent SLO violation

SECONDS_PER_OUTPUT_TOKEN_DIAGNOSTIC.violation_definition: not counted toward single/compound SLO violation status

THROUGHPUT_DIAGNOSTIC.aggregation_level: run-level successful completions divided by measured arrival-to-completion window
THROUGHPUT_DIAGNOSTIC.justification: Raw throughput is demand-dependent and cannot be a universal counted SLO when offered load varies.

threshold.procedure: diagnostic/capacity metric only; not counted as a universal SLO

THROUGHPUT_DIAGNOSTIC.violation_definition: not counted toward single/compound SLO violation status

TOTAL_LATENCY_SLO.justification: End-to-end request completion latency captures downstream and combined effects.

threshold.procedure: Calibrate in a dedicated pre-campaign SLO calibration step before Phase 6 formal outcomes exist. Use one-sided future-run prediction limits with alpha=0.05. Formal Phase 6 outcome data must not be used to set thresholds.

TOTAL_LATENCY_SLO.violation_definition: run-level p95 total latency > calibrated threshold

TTFT_SLO.baseline_source: publication campaign baseline repetitions; Phase 4C confirms medium input and load perturb TTFT
TTFT_SLO.justification: TTFT is the primary user-visible prefill/queue symptom.

threshold.procedure: Calibrate in a dedicated pre-campaign SLO calibration step before Phase 6 formal outcomes exist. Use one-sided future-run prediction limits with alpha=0.05. Formal Phase 6 outcome data must not be used to set thresholds.

compound_violation_definition.compound_slo_violation: Two or more frozen SLOs are violated by run-level aggregates in the same measured run.
compound_violation_definition.single_slo_violation: Exactly one frozen SLO is violated by a run-level aggregate.
compound_violation_definition.window: whole measured run after unscored warm-up; request-level rows support diagnosis but do not define independent repetitions
